title: A conviction of direct acquaintance is a fact of psychology, not a datum

statements.text: Feeling directly acquainted with phenomenal consciousness is a fact of personal psychology, at best an unshakable intuition, not a datum. As with a lady sawn in half, the intuition should wait until the physical alternatives have been canvassed.

sources.quote: that’s a fact of personal psychology, at best an unshakable intuition, not a datum
